propositions: Three independent near-duplicate detached-child spawn sites (push.py, enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py) repeat PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, stdio discipline, and cwd logic
A defect (missing cwd parameter) present at all three sites propagated by deliberate code imitation across separate tickets, demonstrating risk of future bugs following the same pattern

Consolidate the three sites behind a single testable helper `spawn_detached()` in `src/rebar/_proc.py` that owns the bootstrap, detach flags, and cwd logic while preserving per-caller exception handling and environment construction
A static test must enforce that the detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste sites
The gc_trigger.py site that landed concurrently must be refactored into the consolidated helper to complete the consolidation criterion
The cwd fallback in repo_root must be explicitly decided (accept raising posture) and documented to establish the contract for long-lived in-process workers
